notes.subject: נמהרה
notes.rationale: Root מהר 'to hasten': 'carried headlong/swept away' (KJV/BSB) vs 'made foolish' (Geneva) vs 'hastened' (YLT).

notes.subject: נפתלים
notes.rationale: From פתל 'to twist' — literally 'the twisted ones', picturing crooked counsel; the physical picture is lost in 'cunning'.

notes.subject: sira
notes.rationale: Eliphaz describes how Elohim secretly traps the clever — hidden reversal of human plans.

translation: A bɛ dɔnnitigiw minɛ u yɛrɛ ka jujuguya kɔnɔ, ani cogo-juguw ka lasisi bɛ teliya ka saabɔ.
